AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator record granting master control over birthday roster and automation settings.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

role.description: Role identifier for master admin control.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BirthdayContact.title: BirthdayContact
BirthdayContact.description: Master birthday record managed from Admin Control with automated greeting configuration.

userId.description: UID of the user/admin who owns or seeded this record.

name.description: Full name of the friend or employee.

birthDate.description: Date of birth formatted as DD-MM-YYYY.

relationship.description: Department or relationship label (e.g., Colleague, Friend, Family).

phone.description: Optional phone number for SMS/WhatsApp wishes.

autoMessageTemplate.description: Master message template automatically sent on their special day.

autoSendEnabled.description: Whether automated birthday greeting is enabled from Admin Control.

notifyAllUsers.description: Whether all installed app users are intimated on their special day.

lastWishedYear.description: Last calendar year an automated greeting was dispatched (0 if never).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

GreetingPost.title: GreetingPost
GreetingPost.description: A personalized birthday wish from a user or automated birthday intimation from Admin Control.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who created the wish.

senderName.description: Name of the sender or Admin Auto-Pilot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the greeting was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the greeting was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/birthdays/{birthdayId}.description: Master collection of employee and friend birthdays.

/greetings/{greetingId}.description: Collection of birthday wishes and all-user intimations.
